quarterly_data.quarter: Teradyne Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference 2026 (09-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CEO Greg Smith gave the base and the upper end of the semiconductor capital spend frame behind the test TAM: 'last year, kind of $120 billion, moving on towards $250 billion or even $300 billion of semiconductor capital spend in the 2028 to 2030 period of time.' He is not sure test keeps rising as a percentage of that spend, but expects it to increase in proportion to it. He also gave the business mix: semiconductor test is about 80% of revenue ('A little bit more for semi test recently because it has grown so quickly'), robotics about 10% and product test about another 10%.
quarterly_data.figure: semiconductor capital spend $120 billion last year, moving towards $250 billion or even $300 billion in the 2028 to 2030 period; semiconductor about 80% of revenue, robotics about 10%, product test about another 10%
